issues.legal_issue: Whether criminal proceedings for cheating and criminal breach of trust can continue where the allegations concern benami property transactions and the Benami Transactions (Prohibition) Act bars civil claims to enforce rights in the property.

Whether allegations of failure to transfer the claimed share of land or profits, without fraudulent or dishonest intent at the inception of the transactions, disclose the offences of cheating or criminal breach of trust.
Whether profane abuse, without an obscene utterance in or near a public place, constitutes an offence under Section 294(b) of the Indian Penal Code.
Whether the material in the complaint and charge sheet was sufficient to make out criminal intimidation under Section 506(ii) of the Indian Penal Code.
